reminder.notes:
Release v2.23.0

### Features
- New App Logo: Implemented a modern 3D multicolor ribbon bell icon.
- App Theme Overhaul: Aligned light and dark theme colors to match the new icon's electric blue, indigo, and slate palette.
- Motion Gestures: Added optional gesture-based snooze and dismiss actions (flip to snooze, shake to dismiss).
- Location Picker History: Added interactive saved locations chips with long-press delete and add-current capabilities in the map picker.
- Actionable App Widgets: Added Complete and Snooze buttons directly onto the home-screen app widget rows with instant UI feedback and native alarm cancellation.

### Bug fixes
- Resolved minor layout and deprecation issues, updating obsolete withOpacity calls to withValues.
- Fixed a possible issue in the widget rendering where row IDs were not mapped, allowing clean complete and snooze events back to the native scheduler.

ai-scanner.notes:
# AI Scanner 1.5.0 — Private screenshots stay private

Screenshots that hold a one-time code, card number, password or ID number are now recognised on the
device and kept out of sight until you ask for them. And when something goes wrong, Settings now
has a log of what the app actually did, ready to copy into a bug report.

### Features

Private items shield:
- Codes, card numbers, passwords and ID numbers are detected as screenshots are scanned, entirely
  on-device (pattern matching plus a checksum test on card-shaped numbers, so order and tracking
  numbers are not flagged). Nothing is uploaded, as always.
- Flagged items are blurred behind a lock in the Library grid, search results and Collections. The
  item stays searchable and tappable — only its pixels are withheld from anyone looking over your
  shoulder.
- Opening one keeps the note and the extracted text hidden until you tap Show. The value is written
  out in the note, so blurring only the picture would not have hidden it.
- "Export for dev review" no longer includes them. That bundle is meant to leave the phone, and it
  used to zip up every card and password screenshot along with everything else. The export's README
  now states how many items were withheld.
- Detection is a best guess, so any item can be marked or unmarked from its own screen, and your
  decision survives later rescans.
- Settings > Privacy holds the global on/off switch and "Rescan for private content", which checks
  already-scanned items without re-reading your folder or running the AI model.

Diagnostics log:
- Settings > Troubleshooting shows a step-by-step trail of what the app did: startup, which folder
  or album the scan read and how many images were new, permission refusals, model downloads and
  their resumes, summarizer and embedding failures, update checks and share-sheet handoffs.
- One tap copies or shares the whole log with the app version and Android version attached. That is
  the bug report. Every one of those steps could previously fail silently with no way to see why.

### Bug fixes

- The dev-review export bundled private screenshots (cards, passwords, one-time codes) into a file
  meant for sharing. It now excludes them.
- Failures in the summarizer, the embedding step, the folder scan, storage permissions, the model
  download, the update check and the share sheet were all swallowed silently. They are now recorded
  in the diagnostics log.

Note: screenshots scanned before this update are not marked private until you run
Settings > Privacy > "Rescan for private content" once.

mirrordrive.notes:
Release v0.13.8+33

### Features
- Added Google Drive rename detection to avoid uploading modified/renamed files from scratch.
- Added custom ignore pattern manager in Settings to filter sync folders/files line-by-line.
- Added CPU wakelock to keep the phone awake during large background or interactive syncs.
- Implemented Google Drive resumable streaming uploads in constant memory, preventing Out-Of-Memory (OOM) errors for large files.
- Run duplicate files deletion in the background with a real-time progress card in the app.

### Bug fixes
- None.

twinclean.notes:
Show the app version and PNSJY branding in Settings

Settings now ends with the current app version and the PNSJY store branding, so every
PNSJY app presents the same footer.

### Features

- The Settings screen now shows the installed app version and a PNSJY brand footer as its
  last two items, consistent across all PNSJY apps.

### Bug fixes

No user-facing bug fixes in this release.
